parallel.requirements: Recognized a Py2JS task for yaml/test8.py: reproduce argparse --a parsing and yaml.dump(yaml.safe_load(args.a), allow_unicode=True) in pure ESM .mjs files under /output.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: Chose parent-owned implementation plus a background workflow with nine parallel behavior-probe domains; the parent retained final output responsibility but never reached the entry file.
parallel.implementation: Parent probed executable behavior, launched workflow probes, and wrote lower-level YAML modules such as errors, chars, reader, tokens, scanner, parser, resolver, constructor, loader, emitter, and helpers.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: The delivered artifact directory contained only lib/*.mjs modules and no test8.mjs entry point, so no runnable integrated Node program was delivered.
parallel.verification: Verification consisted of executable probes and limited module smoke checks; there was no final evaluator-aligned execution of a completed test8.mjs.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: The official status records timeout/process failure and artifact validation failure because expected_entry test8.mjs was absent, producing 0/165 official tests passed.

serial.requirements: Recognized the same Py2JS task and probed argparse, YAML parsing, dumping, Unicode, formatting, and ESM output constraints from the executable and prompt.
serial.plan_and_ownership: Worked serially in the main trajectory with workflows disabled and no subagents; the single parent owned probing, implementation, and delivery.
serial.implementation: Performed local behavior probes and wrote a broader module set including chars, errors, pytypes, pyfloat, base64, tokens, events, resolver, reader, scanner, parser, composer, constructor, representer, serializer, and scalarAnalysis.
serial.integration_and_delivery: Like the parallel run, the artifact directory contained library modules but omitted the required test8.mjs entry point, so the system was not runnable as requested.
serial.verification: Used local executable probes and Node checks during implementation, but did not complete an integrated test8.mjs run before timeout.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: The official completed evaluation also reported 0/165 and artifact validation failure for missing test8.mjs, despite farther progress into serializer/representer modules.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel recognized the prompt requirement to recreate yaml.safe_load/yaml.dump with allow_unicode, ESM .mjs files, manual argv parsing, and /output delivery.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial received and acted on the same prompt requirements, including ESM modules, manual argv parsing, zero external dependencies, and final test8.mjs delivery.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No material requirement-recognition split is visible; both ultimately missed the concrete delivery requirement for the entry file.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel decomposed behavior discovery into nine workflow probe domains while the parent wrote implementation modules and implicitly retained assembly responsibility.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial kept probing and implementation in one parent trajectory because workflow and task tools were disabled, with zero subagents recorded.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel introduced a large child-agent research layer; serial used a single-owner local strategy without delegation.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel child prompts supplied executable details, capture instructions, and domain-specific probe scopes; they were research briefs rather than component interface contracts.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial retained all context in the main trajectory through local probes and local implementation decisions, so there were no child briefs or handoff interfaces.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The context difference is breadth and handoff surface, not a proven omitted child requirement or missing inter-component API contract.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel wrote foundational YAML library modules and an emitter, but the trajectory never shows creation of the required test8.mjs entry point.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote similar foundations and progressed into representer, serializer, and scalarAnalysis modules, but also stopped before creating test8.mjs.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial progressed somewhat farther in implementation surface; both omitted the same executable entry deliverable.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel workflow children completed and journaled probe results after stalled-domain retries, while the parent continued implementation and closed without a final deliverable.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child result lifecycle to retrieve or join; all results were local command outputs in the main trajectory.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had child result management overhead and a large aggregate probe result; serial avoided that lifecycle entirely.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel final artifact validation found only library modules in the artifact directory and no expected test8.mjs entry file.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial artifact validation likewise found only library modules, including later serializer/representer files, and no expected test8.mjs entry file.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both failed integration/delivery at the same missing-entry boundary; there is no observed shared-state collision explaining the failure.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel ran many behavioral probes and some module checks, but official evaluation completed with 0/165 and no delivered entry artifact.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial also ran many probes and local checks, but official evaluation likewise completed with 0/165 and no delivered entry artifact.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Neither run performed or passed evaluator-aligned acceptance on a complete test8.mjs program; the official outcome is not discordant.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel timed out after using 11 subagents and a workflow consuming 936459 child tokens and 203 child tool calls.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial also timed out, but with zero subagents, zero workflow tasks, and zero workflow child tokens.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The budget profile differs sharply: parallel spent a large portion of work on child fan-out while serial spent its budget entirely in the parent trajectory.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The current completed official evaluations are concordant failures: both parallel and serial have solution_passed false, 0 of 165 tests passed, and artifact validation failure because expected_entry test8.mjs is missing. The concrete task-solving difference is process rather than official result: parallel used a broad nine-domain child workflow while writing lower-level modules, whereas serial probed and implemented locally and reached later serializer/representer modules. Neither delivered the required executable entry file.
parallel_contributors: Broad workflow fan-out and stalled-domain retries consumed substantial child-agent budget while final assembly remained unfinished.
Parent implementation stopped at library modules and never created the requested test8.mjs entry point.
serial_contributors: Serial avoided delegation and kept context local, but still timed out before final entry assembly.
Serial progressed into representer and serializer modules but did not package a runnable deliverable.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Serial wrote representer, serializer, pyfloat, base64, and scalarAnalysis modules that do not appear in the parallel artifact list.
Parallel wrote an emitter module and related YAML foundations but not a complete runnable program.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no discordant outcome; retained parallel pattern is an adverse process contributor, not an outcome-differential cause
